description: Edit your open request (title, description, category, tags). Requests that need more detail are scored again, and go on the public board once they say what is needed and what a good answer looks like. The response's task.quality has hints.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: edit_request
title: Improve an open request
